title: fix(objectql)!: a string-typed field refuses a Date, a Map, a Set, a class instance or a typed array (#29645)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8N5m96xEWaAue5HPrCydye4)_
Fixes #29645

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches writing a `Date`, `Map`, `Set`, class instance or typed array into a text-family field (`git grep` of both trees: zero hits), and the refusal reuses the existing catalog sentence.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:文本类字段(text、textarea、email、url、phone 等 12 种)收到 `Date`、`Map`、`Set`、类实例或类型化数组时，现在一律以 `invalid_type` 拒收，与普通对象、数组已有的拒收同一句话;判定改用选项字段(#29562)已在用的 `isObjectValue`,没有复制新函数。
- **为什么改**:原来的对象判定只认普通对象，其它对象按字符串读法放行：内存驱动把对象原样存下,SQLite 把 `Date` 存成纪元数字 `"1767312000000.0"`,`Map`/`Set` 存成 `"{}"`;email/url/phone 只是碰巧被格式校验拦下。
- **风险与回滚**:是收窄，只影响引擎写入口(流程、钩子、服务端代码);JSON 请求体带不出这些值，REST 调用方无变化。email/url/phone 上这类对象的错误码由格式码变为 `invalid_type`。旧行不改写。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts` 字符串分支 `isObjectValue(value)` 那一处;`record-validator.text-object-value.test.ts`;`packages/rest/src/engine-sqlite-text-object-value.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/validation/record-validator.text-object-value.test.ts`,预期 140 个用例全绿。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.ts`, the `BOUNDED_STRING_FIELD_TYPES` arm: its shape test was `isPlainObjectValue(value) || Array.isArray(value)`, which is prototype-strict, so a `Date`, `Map`, `Set`, class instance or typed array passed on its string reading. It now asks `isObjectValue(value)`, the option arms' test from #29562, and names the shape with that card's `receivedObjectShape`: no copy of either. The wire code (`invalid_type`), the message key (`invalid_value_shape`) and the detail (`expected a string, received an object` / `an array`) are the ones a plain object already got. It is still a shape test, ahead of `shapeOnly`, so a readonly field's value is judged the same way.
- Docblocks only, same file: the file header's string-types line, the `isObjectValue` / `receivedObjectShape` docblocks, and the #29241 "not touched" paragraph of `normalizeNumericStringValues` now say "any object". `normalizeBlankTypedRow` is untouched.
- Changeset `.changeset/29645-text-field-refuses-any-object.md`: `@objectstack/objectql` patch, BREAKING banner, both declaration lines, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, FROM / TO and the remedy.

## Why

Measured on `origin/main` @ `7dae3b3c` (base) and on this branch (head `2e8ba408`), through the engine's insert, update by id and update by predicate, on SQLite (the physical column, read with the driver's query builder) and driver-memory (the engine's read). Twelve types × five values × three doors × two drivers:

| value | base, 9 types (text, textarea, password, markdown, html, richtext, code, signature, qrcode): SQLite stored | base, those 9: memory read | base, email / url / phone | head, all 12, both drivers, all 3 doors |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| `new Date(...)` | `"1767312000000.0"` | the `Date` itself | `invalid_email` / `invalid_url` / `invalid_phone` | `invalid_type` |
| `new Map(...)` | `"{}"` | the `Map` | same format codes | `invalid_type` |
| `new Set(...)` | `"{}"` | the `Set` | same format codes | `invalid_type` |
| a class instance `{ k: 1 }` | `'{"k":1}'` | the instance | same format codes | `invalid_type` |
| `new Uint8Array([1, 2])` | `'{"0":1,"1":2}'` | the typed array | same format codes | `invalid_type` |
| plain-string control | stored as sent | as sent | as sent (a valid address, URL, phone) | stored as sent |

`password` reads back masked on both sides, so its stored column is the only answer there. The format types refused by accident: `String(value)` failed their regex. Head refuses the shape first on all twelve, so those three answer `invalid_type` instead of their format code.

## Tests

- New `packages/objectql/src/validation/record-validator.text-object-value.test.ts` (140 cases): the spec set's twelve members pinned by name; each type × `Date` / `Map` / `Set` / class instance / typed array × insert / update refuses with `code` + `constraint.type` + detail; a per-type plain-string control (a valid address, URL and phone on the three format types); the message names field, type and shape; the readonly scope refuses; a number and a boolean keep #29241 (written as their string, then judged); the door leaves an object as sent; a `json` field still holds a `Date` or a `Map`; engine insert, insertMany, update by id and update by predicate answer `VALIDATION_FAILED` and the driver is never written, with a string control that is.
- New `packages/rest/src/engine-sqlite-text-object-value.test.ts` (6 cases): the same five values on a real `ObjectQL` + sqlite `SqlDriver`, all three doors refused, the physical row absent or unchanged; control: a string stored as sent and a number stored as `"42"`.
- No existing test changed.

## Acceptance notes

- Reach is the engine doors only (flows, hooks, server code), as the card says; REST over JSON cannot carry these values, so no REST pin is added.
- The `currency` arm's `isPlainObjectValue` (sentence choice only, never the verdict) is untouched and is the helper's one remaining caller.
- Out of scope, noted not filed: none found.
